About.title: About Sidhomarg Foundation
About.text: We are a non-governmental organization that is committed to providing food, education, and healthcare to people in need, especially in rural and marginalized communities. We believe that everyone deserves to live a healthy and dignified life, regardless of their background or circumstances.
About.mottoText: “Sarve Janaha Sukhino Bhavantu” means: may all people be happy.

Footer.aboutText: We are a non-governmental organization that is committed to providing food, education, and healthcare to people in need, especially in rural and marginalized communities. We believe that everyone deserves to live a healthy and dignified life, regardless of their background or circumstances. We offer a variety of programs and services, including school feeding programs, adult literacy programs, mobile health clinics, and vocational training programs. Our programs are designed to help people meet their basic needs and to develop the skills and knowledge they need to improve their lives.
